tokens.name: surface-background
tokens.usage: App canvas behind everything. Code: var(--background).

tokens.name: surface-card
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, table containers, TabsBar. Code: var(--card).

tokens.name: surface-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, select content, popovers. Code: var(--popover).

tokens.name: surface-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill; neutral-emphasis badge fill; import chips. Code: var(--secondary).

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Tab list track, avatar fallback, neutral badge and alert, showcase stages. Code: var(--muted).

tokens.name: surface-accent
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ghost and outline buttons, menu items, skeletons. Code: var(--accent).

tokens.name: surface-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar and nav rail. Code: var(--sidebar).

tokens.name: surface-sidebar-accent
tokens.usage: Active sidebar item. Code: var(--sidebar-accent).

tokens.name: surface-white
tokens.usage: Form field background (input, select, checkbox, outline button). White in Light, #131C31 in Dark. Not the card surface.

tokens.name: text-foreground
tokens.usage: Body copy, headings, values, on every surface-* token. Also the tooltip and neutral-bold alert fill. Code: var(--foreground).

tokens.name: text-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Labels, helper text, timestamps, section labels, placeholders; legible on surface-background, -card, -muted, -white. Code: var(--muted-foreground).

tokens.name: text-secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on surface-secondary fills. Code: var(--secondary-foreground).

tokens.name: text-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the blue brand-primary fill and on bold destructive, success and info fills. Code: var(--primary-foreground).

tokens.name: text-primary-text
tokens.usage: Blue text on light surfaces and on tint-primary-15: the AA companion of brand-primary. Light, neutral and ghost badges; links on a tint. Code: var(--primary-text).

tokens.name: text-destructive-text
tokens.usage: Error text on surfaces and on tint-destructive-15. Code: var(--destructive-text).

tokens.name: text-success-text
tokens.usage: Success text on surfaces and on tint-success-15. Code: var(--success-text).

tokens.name: text-warning-text
tokens.usage: Warning text on surfaces and on tint-warning-15. Code: var(--warning-text).

tokens.name: text-info-text
tokens.usage: Info text on surfaces and on tint-info-15. Code: var(--info-text).

tokens.name: text-accent-teal-text
tokens.usage: Teal text on surfaces and on tint-accent-teal-15. Code: var(--accent-teal-text).

tokens.name: text-archived-text
tokens.usage: Archived status text; also the bold archived badge fill. Code: var(--status-archived-text).

tokens.name: border-border
tokens.usage: Every hairline: cards, tables, separators, dividers. The global default border colour. Decorative only (below 3:1). Code: var(--border).

tokens.name: border-input
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders; the switch off track. Code: var(--input).

tokens.name: border-ring
tokens.usage: Focus border, paired with the focus-ring shadow. Code: var(--ring).

tokens.name: border-sidebar
tokens.usage: Sidebar edges. Code: var(--sidebar-border).

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: THE action colour: primary button, checked controls, active tab underline, progress, links. One primary action per view. Code: var(--primary).

tokens.name: brand-accent
tokens.usage: Orange. The logo target dot and brand marks; at most one highlight per view. Never a status colour. Code: var(--brand-accent).

tokens.name: brand-mark-bg
tokens.usage: BrandMarkTile background. Code: var(--brand-mark-bg).

tokens.name: brand-chevron-back
tokens.usage: Logo only: the back chevron. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: brand-chevron-front
tokens.usage: Logo only: the front chevron. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: brand-wordmark
tokens.usage: Logo only: the wordmark. Do not use in UI.

tokens.name: status-destructive
tokens.usage: Failed and error dots, destructive buttons, bold destructive badges; text on it is text-primary-foreground. Code: var(--destructive).

tokens.name: status-success
tokens.usage: Completed and active dots, bold success badges. Code: var(--success).

tokens.name: status-warning
tokens.usage: Running, retrying and waiting dots, bold warning badges; text on it is status-warning-foreground. Code: var(--warning).

tokens.name: status-warning-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on the bold warning fill, both modes. Code: var(--warning-foreground).

tokens.name: status-info
tokens.usage: Info badges and alerts. Cyan, so it never reads as the brand blue. Code: var(--info).

tokens.name: status-accent-teal
tokens.usage: Initializing, provisioning and resuming states. Code: var(--accent-teal).

tokens.name: status-accent-teal-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on the bold teal fill, both modes. Code: var(--accent-teal-foreground).

tokens.name: status-archived
tokens.usage: Archived deployments. Code: var(--status-archived).

tokens.name: tint-primary-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis badge and alert fill (primary at 15%). Text on it: the matching text-*-text token.

tokens.name: tint-primary-30
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis alert border (primary at 30%).

tokens.name: tint-destructive-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis badge and alert fill (destructive at 15%). Text on it: the matching text-*-text token.

tokens.name: tint-destructive-30
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis alert border (destructive at 30%).

tokens.name: tint-success-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis badge and alert fill (success at 15%). Text on it: the matching text-*-text token.

tokens.name: tint-success-30
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis alert border (success at 30%).

tokens.name: tint-warning-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis badge and alert fill (warning at 15%). Text on it: the matching text-*-text token.

tokens.name: tint-warning-30
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis alert border (warning at 30%).

tokens.name: tint-info-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis badge and alert fill (info at 15%). Text on it: the matching text-*-text token.

tokens.name: tint-info-30
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis alert border (info at 30%).

tokens.name: tint-accent-teal-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis teal badge fill. Text on it: text-accent-teal-text.

tokens.name: tint-archived-15
tokens.usage: Light-emphasis archived badge fill. Text on it: text-archived-text.

tokens.name: tint-foreground-20
